stories.text: 🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 72% / 46%, Ramosverse 18% / 5.7%.
⚡ Early edge: Ruffing the Passer went from 38% to 57% against The Mahomies, led by Hubbard (24.80 pts).
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 75% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 42% with none (now 64%).
📈 LINE MOVE: PHI @ WSH: PHI −2.5 at open, WSH −6 now. 6 league starters in it, led by J. Daniels (TDsMaGee).
🎟️ RAFFLE WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane (26% to take the ticket) is chasing Ruffing the Passer's 66.94 — 50.34 pts back with 10 starters still to play.
🪑 The one that got away (on the bench): TDsMaGee has started RJ Harvey just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 3, 4 and 6 would have meant 3 more wins by now.
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 LINE MOVE: IND @ JAX: JAX −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. 7 league starters in it, led by P. Washington (Ramosverse).
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 266.82 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (73.12 pts) and McLaughlin (66.00 pts).
🏈 5 matchups are still up for grabs, and Mr. Action Jackson vs Kyle Tucker (Kyle Tucker 50%) is the tightest.
📈 TRENDING: Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI) is one of the most-added players in fantasy over the past 24 hours. Nobody here has him.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Kirbo Crushers added Jake Bates (K, projected 8.55 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
